sources.title: Solenopsisbot/solace-alpha · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Solace Alpha Solace Alpha is an experimental 4B parameter model built for one thing: actually having a good conversation. I got tired of AI that sounds like a heavily-litigated corporate press release. Solace is trained to reject the usual AI tropes—no excessive positivity, no sycophantic agreement, and absolutely no making things up.

sources.title: GitHub - Solenopsisbot/openmodelindex: Public queryable index of non ...
sources.snippet: Extracts benchmarks — parses the model-index YAML frontmatter into normalized rows and canonicalizes benchmark names (MMLU, GSM8K, HellaSwag, HumanEval, IFEval, GPQA, MATH, …). Serves it — a SQLite index behind a FastAPI app: browse/search/filter models, per-benchmark leaderboards, and a full JSON API.
